name: location-input
title: Location Input
description: A Google Maps address autocomplete input with Popover dropdown. Includes a Multi variant for collecting an ordered list of locations.

migration.guide: v2.3 hardens `Multi` against accidental empty rows and duplicate selections: the add button is disabled until every existing row has a selected place, and each row's suggestion list filters out place IDs already chosen by other rows. `Root` gains an `excludePlaceIds` prop that drives the dedupe and is also useful standalone. v2.2 added the `Multi` variant for collecting a list of locations with add/remove rows, plus a `trailing` slot on `Root` for inlining custom content (e.g. a remove button) inside the input wrapper. `Root` accepts a `types` prop (default `['address']`) controlling the Google Places prediction types — pass `['(cities)']` for city-level autocomplete. v2.1 removes the built-in Google Maps loader — the consuming app must call `setOptions()` and `importLibrary('places')` once at startup (e.g. in a global provider). The `apiKey` prop has been removed. The component syncs its internal search text when the `location` prop changes externally (e.g. form reset). When used inside a `FormField.Root` with a `name` prop, validation is triggered automatically on blur. `hasError` is read from form field context if not provided.

docs.lead: A Google Maps address autocomplete input with async search and place resolution. Use `Multi` to collect a list of locations.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Basic location input with default settings.

examples.title: Multi
examples.description: Collect an ordered list of locations. Each row is an autocomplete input; rows can be added with the trailing button and removed with the inline minus icon (shown when more than `minLocations` rows are visible).

examples.title: Multi with Max
examples.description: Cap the number of locations. The add button is disabled once `maxLocations` is reached.

examples.title: With React Hook Form
examples.description: Used inside a FormField.Root with automatic error handling and validation on blur. Both `Root` and `Multi` auto-bind to RHF: `Root` stores a single `LocationRequest`, `Multi` stores `LocationRequest[]`.

api.name: LocationInput.Root
api.description: Google Maps address autocomplete input. Reads `hasError` and `onBlur` from FormField context when available.

props.name: location
props.description: The current location object. Pass `null` for empty state. The component syncs its internal search text when this prop changes (e.g. on form reset).

props.name: onLocationChange
props.description: Callback when a location is selected or cleared.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Input placeholder text.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon component. Pass `null` to omit the leading icon — `Multi` uses this to render unadorned rows.

props.name: size
props.description: Input size variant.

props.name: hasError
props.description: Error state. Automatically read from FormField context if not provided.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disabled state. Automatically read from FormField context if not provided.

props.name: countryRestrictions
props.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for autocomplete restrictions.

props.name: types
props.description: Google Places autocomplete prediction types. Defaults to street-level addresses; pass `['(cities)']` for city-level autocomplete.

props.name: excludePlaceIds
props.description: Place IDs to filter out of the suggestion list. Used by `Multi` to prevent the same address from being picked across rows.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Optional slot rendered inside the input wrapper after the input. Used by `Multi` to inline a per-row remove button; can also hold custom adornments.

api.name: LocationInput.Multi
api.description: Collects a list of locations. Renders one `Root` per row with an inline remove button, plus an add-row button below. Prevents duplicate selections by filtering each row's suggestion list against the place IDs already picked in other rows, and disables the add button until every existing row has a selected place. Auto-binds to React Hook Form as `LocationRequest[]` when inside a `FormField.Root`.

props.name: locations
props.description: The list of selected locations. Optional — auto-binds to RHF when inside `FormField.Root`.

props.name: onLocationsChange
props.description: Callback when the list changes (rows added, removed, or a row's place is selected/changed).

props.name: minLocations
props.description: Minimum visible rows. The remove button is hidden once this floor is reached.

props.name: maxLocations
props.description: Maximum number of rows. When reached, the add button is disabled.

props.name: addLabel
props.description: Label text for the add-row button.

props.name: size
props.description: Input size variant applied to every row.

props.name: hasError
props.description: Error state applied to every row. Read from FormField context if not provided.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disabled state applied to every row and the add button. Read from FormField context if not provided.

props.name: countryRestrictions
props.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for autocomplete restrictions, applied to every row.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder for each row's input.

types.name: LocationRequest
types.description: The resolved location object returned by `onLocationChange`, or `null` when cleared.
